_: Every field of caller-supplied calldata that reaches state, an event or a guard, and whether execution is forced to confirm the claim it makes. See field_confirmation.py for the classes and the self-test.

classes.STEERING: the field directs a token movement, so a false value punishes the caller and needs no separate check
classes.CONFIRMED: execution reads it AND a check compares it against an observation
classes.DECLARED: it reaches state, an event or a guard, and nothing observes it
